training_findings: The Enterprise first-login setup product scope is captured and valid JSON.
TOD can register the apprenticeship objective and task in local state when all required TOD.ps1 parameters are provided.
TOD can package the task without the earlier target_file_exactly_one materialization blocker.
TOD still does not safely complete default run-task for this Enterprise pattern materialization task class without the compact skip-tail profile.
With -SkipNextTaskSelectionLoop and -SkipPostCompletionTail, TOD publishes a fresh terminal blocked result instead of hanging.
TOD did produce a bounded packet after Codex repaired the packet-formation control plane.

The TOD-authored packet produced a real code change in tmp_remote_mim/core/routers/project_portal.py: enterprise_role, enterprise_setup, and enterprise_launch_ready are now exposed in the account payload.
The target file compiles with python -m py_compile.
TOD still did not complete this as an independent resolution because Codex repaired the materializer and the implementation result publisher hung or was superseded.
A validation-only rerun preserved evidence but was classified as blocked because no material diff occurred.
On the fresh Enterprise observatory target, TOD produced a precise packet-formation blocker, then completed a source-anchor observation artifact.
TOD then completed packet-body synthesis from the source-anchor artifact after the task was corrected to separate artifact target, source target, and artifact_write mode.
TOD applied the synthesized packet through execute-chat-task and validated the file with python -m py_compile.
The first synthesized insertion used a non-unique closing-section anchor and created a duplicate prompt; the cleanup task removed the duplicate and validation proved the prompt appears exactly once.
This is guided capability improvement, not independent capability acquisition, because Codex coached the task-shape corrections and duplicate cleanup.
A later no-coaching repeat attempt on tmp_remote_mim/core/routers/enterprises.py failed: TOD ran validation but did not produce a packet or material source change.
TOD recovered one rung by capturing an exact source anchor for the Enterprise get endpoint, proving inspection still works after the failed no-op attempt.
The current unresolved capability is independent new_text synthesis from inspected current source and product intent.
A cleaner no-snippet packet synthesis test produced a precise blocker artifact instead of a ready packet, confirming that autonomous current-code packet body synthesis is not yet demonstrated.
The packet artifact validator also needs a stricter ready-vs-blocked distinction so packet_candidate_ready=false cannot be treated as implementation-ready completion.

next_required_training_objective.goal: TOD independently selects a fresh harmless Enterprise slice, creates the source anchor, synthesizes a packet through an existing lane, applies it, validates it, and publishes terminal evidence without Codex shaping route/field intent.
acceptance: TOD selects exactly one fresh harmless Enterprise target from current code.
TOD names the user-visible behavior delta and why it is harmless.
TOD captures a unique current source anchor.
TOD synthesizes packet old_text/new_text without Codex snippet/body.
TOD applies the packet through an execution path that returns terminal evidence for the same task ID.
Validation proves compile success and content appears exactly once.
Apprenticeship status advances to independent_demo_passed only if Codex did not provide target, route/field intent, old_text, or new_text.

new_training_debt.reason: A task can produce material code change and validation while the terminal result remains hung, blocked, or superseded by unrelated work.
Validation-only tasks should be able to complete when intended evidence is present and no material diff is expected.
Packet formation tasks must distinguish output artifact target, input evidence artifact, and source target so the materializer does not treat evidence inputs as competing target files.
Packet synthesis must prove the insert or replace anchor is unique, or include validation that catches unintended duplicate insertions before completion.
TOD can inspect source and apply a supplied packet, but it has not demonstrated independent synthesis of the bounded new_text body from current code and product intent.
Packet artifact validation must distinguish packet_candidate_ready=true from packet_candidate_ready=false blocker artifacts.

current_credit_decision.narrow_capability_acquired: TOD can synthesize and apply a Python route-shell old_text/new_text packet from current source anchor plus route intent without Codex providing a snippet.
current_credit_decision.remaining_gap: TOD still needs a no-coaching fresh slice where it selects target, route/field intent, source anchor, packet synthesis path, apply path, validation, and terminal evidence without Codex task shaping.
